Subject:- Procedure for Cancellation of Exemption - Regarding.
Sir,

Section 17(1)(a) and 17(2) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952 provides for grant of exemption to the applicant
establishments from the operation of the provisions of the EPF Scheme, 1952 and Section 17(4) of the Act
provides for cancellation of exemption.

2. Head Office has issued guidelines vide Circular No. Exem/6(20)08/DL/NZ/Vol.| /30327 Dated:
30.07.2009{copy thereof enclosed for ready reference) regarding procedure to be followed by the field offices
while processing cases relating to cancellation/surrender of exemption.

3. In recent communications, Ministry of Labour & Employment has instructed that audited accounts of the
Trust of the exempted establishment and an assessment whether any liability is likely to arise on EPFO as a
result of the rate of interest announced by EPFO being also admissible to these subscribers, is also required to
be submitted.

4, Therefore, it is instructed that in future while forwarding the proposals for cancellation/surrender of
exemption of the establishments, the above said requirement be fulfilled invariably by the RPFCs as a standard
procedure in all such cases so that there is no cross subsidization by other subscribers. In case any liability
arises, it may also be indicated how RPFC proposes to deal with it.

5 It is also instructed to get the fund audited and ascertain the financial health of the Trust by a third party
auditor in accordance with the instructions contained in Head Office circular No. E-HIl/Misc./14/Exem/Third Party
Compliance Audit/2682 dated 30.04.2012 in all such cases in future.

6. It is further instructed wherever any proposal for cancetlation/surrender of exemption is pending at any
level, this exercise be got completed and a report be furnished to the Head Office urgently.

Enclosure: As above.

Yours faithfully,

Sub:- Procedure for the cancellation of exemption-reg.
Sir,

To,

It is observed in the recent past that ROs/SROs are not submitting the requisite
documents while forwarding proposals for cancellation of exemption. In order to ensure a
standardized procedure in such cases the following guidelines are enumerated for your
guidance:-

2) In cases of surrender of exemption by the employer on its own volition, the following
documents are required to be submitted to the Head Office while recommending any
proposal for cancellation of exemption:-

(i) An application from the employer addressed to the Appropriate Govt. requesting for
surrender of exemption.

(ii) A copy of resolution of the BOT.

(iti) A report of the concerned RPFC. regarding up to date compliance status.

(iv) A copy of the notification wherein exemption was originally granted by the appropriate
Government.

3) In Cases where violation of conditions of exemption have been detected, the exemption
can be cancelled u/s 17(4) of the EPF act, duly following the procedure which includes
issue of a show cause notice to the establishment by the appropriate government/authority
detailing the violation of the conditions of exemption In this regard, RPFC shall forward
the following:-

(i) A draft Show Cause Notice to Head Office mentioning the violation of the conditions of
exemption & other defaults committed by (he establisliment, Head Office shall forward
the same to the appropriate Govt. after approval of the competent authority.

(ii)

dues, and submission of retums & punitive actions if any initiated against the
establishment alongwith their status etc.

(iii) {uw case an establishment is not complying with any of the conditions governing grant of
exemption and if the employer is willing to surrender exemption, consent of the majority
of employees need not be insisted.

In this context your reference is also invited to Head Office circular No.
Co-ord/11(24)05/Admn_Inst/Cir/25000 dt. 16/06/05 wherein detailed procedure was stipulated in
the light of the judgment of the Hon’ble Kolkata High Court in the matter of M/s Delta Ltd. Vs
RPFC. It is also be reiterated that besides-cancellation of exemption, RPFCs may initiate all
other actions as stipulated u/s 7A, 14B, 8, 14 against the defaulting exempted establishments as
per the prescribed procedure.

It is requested to follow the above procedure scrupulously in all cases in future.

Yours faithfully,

(P. SudhagkarBabu)

Additional Central P.F, Commissioner (Compliance)
